versions.changelog:
volcengine-documentation 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 火山引擎官方文档查询工具.
- Supports official document search and full content retrieval for all 火山引擎 products.
- Provides decision logic for when to use search vs. fetch (including handling of URLs with query parameters).
- Ensures all responses include official document links as sources.
- Offers CLI usage examples and detailed parameter descriptions for both search and fetch functions.
